comment: The paneer tikka was smoky and perfectly spiced loved it
Butter chicken was rich and creamy but a bit too sweet for me
Chicken biryani was excellent the rice was so fragrant
The veg biryani was bland and the vegetables were undercooked
Masala dosa was crispy and the potato filling was delicious
Tandoori chicken was decent but the service was very slow
Paneer pizza was amazing the crust was perfectly crisp
Cold coffee arrived warm and tasted watered down disappointing
Spicy veg pasta had a nice kick would order again
Fish curry was outstanding the coconut gravy was rich and tangy
Chole bhature was oily and the bhature was undercooked
Gulab jamun was soft and the syrup was perfectly sweet
Butter chicken had almost no chicken in it very disappointing
Chocolate brownie was warm and fudgy best dessert here
Paneer tikka was okay nothing special but not bad either
Chicken biryani was good but a little too spicy for me
Spring rolls were soggy and lacked flavor
Lassi was refreshing and perfectly sweet
Veg manchurian was crispy and the sauce had a great balance of flavors
Veg fried rice was average needed more seasoning
Veg biryani was fantastic loaded with vegetables and great spice
Veg thali was filling and had a good variety of curries
Margherita pizza was cold and the cheese was barely melted
Coke was fine nothing to complain about
Tandoori chicken was juicy and perfectly charred loved it
Masala dosa was cold and the chutney tasted off
Paneer pizza was tasty but arrived later than promised
Best chicken biryani i have had in a long time highly recommend
Spicy veg pasta was too oily and the sauce was too thick
Butter chicken was absolutely delicious will order again
